manara.tech: MENA tech-talent / engineer training platform (co-founders Iliana Montauk, Laila Abudahi). TechCrunch (May 2022) reports a $3M pre-seed led by Stripe with Reid Hoffman, Paul Graham, Eric Ries, Mudassir Sheikha; Seedcamp also invested. No public priced seed or later round found. Caveat: CB Insights (tracker only) lists a ~$2.98M 'Seed VC' in Feb 2023, which is unconfirmed by press and likely the same money; not counted.
